name: Rudiments
description: Pre-industrial craft restored one process at a time. Flax and nettle through full multi-step fibre chains with quality tiers; living nettle ecology with rhizome spread and nitrogen dynamics; reed spread; linseed oil pressing; three tiers of fired clay — porous earthenware, vitrified stoneware and a true porcelain body — with pottery that seeps, wears and shatters when you drop it. Optional compatibility with Wool & More (hand carding), Immersive Fibercraft, Clayworks, String Sense, and Toolsmith when those mods are present. Pre-release — work in progress.
